change_reason: Forward reviews showed repeated cases where correct numbers were distributed across Evidence, Scarcity and Neutral tracks but were not recombined into the same final ticket. V2.8 addresses that architecture gap without retuning legacy scorers from observed outcomes.

fusion_number_pool.ordering: fusion_score desc -> support_count desc -> max component score desc -> number asc

review_metrics: fusion pool winning-number coverage and original pool ranks
exact winning combination rank if candidate-eligible
best matching fusion combination and original rank
first rank reaching each hit count
Top10 Top50 Top100 full-ranking hit summaries
final ticket hits by Evidence Scarcity Neutral Fusion origin
promotion_rule: V2.8 remains research-only until multiple forward-frozen target draws have been reviewed. A single successful draw cannot trigger production promotion or retuning.
